name: Sex Trainer
source:
A former socialite that got bored playing around, both mentally and physically, with others.

She gets noticed by the criminal organization for her talents and is recruited into the organization.

She now helps to sexually develop the skill sets of the sex slave in training and she enjoys the challenge the job provides her. 

She meets Julie to improve Julie's sexual skills at pleasing her future master.
